content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "no", "applies_why": "The judge text does not weigh any pressed chain against a live link by footing; it disposes of C4 because the targeted curse limb was dropped and no live link remains.", "verdict": "CLEAN", "quote": "D6 vs C4 (Jeremiah 22:30): UNDERDETERMINED -- C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.", "rule_words": "When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.", "room": "pressed against a link — read as covering a live link only, or as covering even a dropped limb; the judge text treats the dropped curse limb as leaving no live link to contradict.", "why": "Because the judge's disposition rests on the dropped-limb status rather than any verse-by-verse stating-verse test, K-C does not govern this text."}
